_schema: src/physics/spec.ts (CarSpec). SI units. Keys starting with _ are comments.
name: 1993 Ford Probe GT (24 Hours of Lemons #619)

suspension._rates: wheel rates. Rear ARB is the ~18 mm Contour/Mystique bar.
suspension._balance: Balance pass (Oct 2026): front bar 18000 -> 32000 N/m (front diameter unknown; a stock GT front bar is much stiffer than the 18 mm rear) and lateral compliance steer (front 0.4 deg/kN toe-out of the turn, rear 0.12 deg/kN in phase). Before: ~0.4 deg/g understeer gradient and a lift at 0.9 g took the rear to 11.7 deg slip; after ~2 deg/g and 3.7 deg. See improvements.md Balance.
suspension._travel: Calibrated: 70 mm droop + 90 mm bump (was 35 + 55). With 35 mm droop the inside rear hit full droop under trail braking and lifted.

tyre._tyre: 225/50R16 200-treadwear street tyre. Calibrated: lateral mu0 1.25 (≈1.2 g steady state), longitudinal mu0 1.20, longitudinal C 1.45 (locked tyre keeps ~75 % of peak, not 52 %).

speedSensitivity._note: lateral friction peak only: -5 % at 110 km/h (T4), -10 % at 121 km/h (T6), none below 100 km/h; brings the autopilot T6 to ~116 km/h (driver A 116), see improvements.md Balance

tyre._grip_note: mu0 lowered from 1.25/1.20 after the v2 centreline rebuild: with real corner radii the logger implies 0.8-1.1 g in most corners (1.2 at T5 after banking), and Coby felt the sim cornered too fast at 1.25.

drivetrain._ratios: overall ratios = engine rpm per mph / 13.5092 (wheel rpm per mph at r = 0.316 m). Measured 3rd 82, 4th 63, 5th 48.5 rpm/mph; 1st and 2nd from gearbox ratios 3.307/1.310 and 1.833/1.310 times 3rd (207.0 and 114.7 rpm/mph). Reverse like 1st.

autoShift._kickdown: Balance/power pass: at 125 km/h in 5th (3800 rpm) on the Rahal climb, full throttle kicks down to 4th (4900 rpm), as driver A's rpm trace shows (4th up the hill to ~5150). After a kickdown the next upshift waits for 5450 rpm, which lands 5th at ~4200, above the 4100 kickdown threshold, so it does not hunt.
autoShift._note: Upshift at 5000 rpm, the median shift point of the team at Laguna (they short-shifted; nobody ran to the 6900 limiter). Downshift below 2600 only if the lower gear lands at or under 5000.

abs._abs: Coby: the race car has ABS but it is crude; a front can lock for about half a second before it acts. Early-90s 3-channel logic, see src/physics/README.md ABS.

brakes._brakes: Calibrated (tools/calibrate): 70 % front below the proportioning-valve knee (pedal 0.25, ~0.35 g), ~80 % front at full pedal, close to the ideal split for this CG; 6000 N·m (performance pads) so threshold braking is grip-limited at ~1.02 g, 11 % above the logger's peak 0.92 g

aero._aero: Calibrated to the logger full-throttle acceleration (tools/calibrate/accel_fit.py): CdA 1.125 m² vs stock 0.66. Roof rack + ray-gun sculpture + inflatable aliens add bluff area, windows out add drag.

surfaces._surfaces: Off pavement (dirt / dry grass past the paved edge; track, pit lane and paved runoff stay at full grip). Each effect fades in over the first 1 m past the edge. See src/physics/NOTES-surface.md.
surfaces._offPavementMu: tyre friction on dry Laguna dirt / dry grass relative to pavement (street tyre on firm dry dirt: ~0.65-0.8). Lower = slipperier; 0.5 would be wet-grass territory.
surfaces._offPavementLateralStiffness: cornering stiffness factor on dirt: the lateral peak moves from 7 to ~10.8 deg slip, so the car slides progressively instead of snapping
surfaces._offPavementRollingResistance: extra rolling resistance / sinkage drag on dirt: dCrr = 0.04 + 0.0015 * v (m/s), per wheel x load; ~0.07 g extra drag at 90 km/h (coast 5 s from 90 km/h: 3.3 m/s more speed lost than on pavement)

steering._shaping: full stick: 32 deg at rest, 20 deg at 50 km/h, 7.7 deg at 116 km/h, 5 deg at 150 km/h (shapingSpeed raised from 13.4 to 18 so T6 can be driven at the limit on a gamepad); lock-to-lock flick 0.25 s at rest, 0.6 s at 100 km/h, 0.75 s at 150 km/h (rateSpeed 30 -> 20 in the balance pass)

hull._hull: box for ground contacts; bumper-line ring + roof corners for walls, trees and buildings
